title: A whole reply allows thanks and questions

captions.physics: Returning to a conclusion understood differently
captions.energy: Encompassing understood substance and remaining reservations

meaning: You can return to a conclusion understood differently and encompass understood substance alongside a reservation remaining, feeling gratitude coexist with doubt without completing everything immediately.
text: Judgement in the physical position of your Vishuddha appears in returning to a conclusion now understood differently. The World in energy supports a wish to encompass understood substance and a remaining reservation. Temperance in emotions allows gratitude and doubt to feel compatible. You can answer a familiar ending differently once its limit becomes clearer. Wholeness requires neither identical impressions nor the disappearance of every remaining question.

For example, you return to “We understand the main point”. Previously heard as closing the entire subject, it now allows “Thank you for explaining, but one question remains”. **An understood point leaves genuine room for doubt**. Gratitude does not disappear because another clarification is needed. Yet an open part does not cancel everything heard. You can name what is clear and what is missing without presenting a pleasant conclusion as final agreement or making remaining doubt proof of a useless exchange.

Difficulty arises if a new question is permitted only after sufficient gratitude to feel harmonious. A whole answer depends on the correct sequence of words again. Constructive World energy helps encompass actual substance, including an imperfectly expressed reservation. You can be grateful and seriously doubtful without compulsory balance; compatible feelings are not measured by a formula, while new understanding requires neither endless continuation nor banning clarification of something genuinely unknown.
